propositions: CLI reference documentation and parser-derived artifacts must be generated from registry enumeration and committed help bytes, eliminating manual regex parsing and hand-maintained command census.
Reference generation checks (gen_cli_help.py --check and gen_cli_reference.py --check) must prove byte-current parity across all parser artifacts.
All help/exit-code/argparse tests must enumerate route sets from the registry via canonical policy derivation rather than hand-reconstructed unions.
A clean no-extras distribution wheel must render every approved help form with exact committed bytes and zero side effects from operations/config/stores/handlers.
Every lazy handler, parser, selector reference and capability-to-extra mapping must be resolved and validated without executing command logic.
Editorial examples and rationale must be structurally separated from generated syntax, linted for top-level spelling correctness, and never override authoritative parser artifacts.
